主要内容: Nicholas Financial Inc appointed Ralph T. Finkenbrink as President and Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Mr. Vosotas, effective June 1, 2014. Kevin D. Bates was appointed Senior Vice President-Branch Operations, and Katie L. MacGillivary was appointed Vice President-Finance, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary. Mr. MacGillivary received $325,000, $225,000, and $150,000, respectively, while Mr. Finkenbrink received a one-time cash bonus of $25,000. Executives will also receive annual cash incentive bonuses, long-term equity compensation, and other modest benefits. The Board expects to enter into written employment agreements with Finkenbrink and Bates.
